repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzhoBbwh8URjwQHde8v

Stage-1 readings · 2026-11-24T04:17Z · area ux-B (claim 7121750501). Read-only on origin/main f46ce5b4a, static source reads, no live probe; nothing written.

**Item 1 — comment and attachment counts: buildable with no new backend.**
- Comments live in `sys_comment` (`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-comment.object.ts`): pair `object_name` + `record_id`, index on both; replies by `parent_id`, `is_resolved`. Attachments live in `sys_attachment` (`packages/platform-objects/src/audit/sys-attachment.object.ts`): `parent_object` + `parent_id`, only on objects with `enable.files: true`.
- One grouped read per counted object over the board's loaded ids goes through the existing door (`POST /data/:object/query` → `engine.aggregate`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-data-crud.ts`; UI `DataSource.queryGroupHeaders`). That is two reads (comments, attachments), not one: a literal "single read for the board" would need a new combined route, which is not recommended.
- Reader permissions apply to the aggregate (per source): `READ_OPS` includes `aggregate` in `plugin-audit/src/comment-access-hooks.ts` and `service-storage/src/attachment-access-hooks.ts`.
- No existing reader counts across many records. The record page counts unresolved threads for one record on the client (`RecordDetailView.tsx` `unresolvedThreadCount`).
- Overlap: epic #36062 stage 2 items 10–11 (batch unresolved-comment counts; a comment mark on list rows and kanban cards) cover the comment half. Not yet filed as sub-issues.

**Item 2 — time in column: no platform source exists.**
- No stage-entered column. `sys_activity` stamps `changed_fields` but is reaped after 14 days (`sys-activity.object.ts` `retention.maxAge: '14d'`) and refuses grouping on `changed_fields` for readers with any withheld field. `sys_audit_log` holds JSON snapshots that cannot be SQL-grouped. HotCRM keeps an app-level `stage_entry_date` on `crm_opportunity`.
- Options: (a) derive from `sys_activity`: exact only under 14 days, nothing for `activities: false`, refused for readers with withheld fields, S–M. (b) A platform `stage_entered_at` system column tied to the object's `stageField` (ADR-0085): engine stamp, read-only, approximate backfill, L, its own card, with an L2 review and likely an ADR note. (b′) A view key naming an author-maintained date field: cheap, but lets an author name a field nobody maintains. (c) Defer time in column out of this card.
- Dev recommendation: (c) now, (b) as its own needs-decision card.

**View setting.** Precedent: `showFieldLabels` / `hideEmptyFields` in `KanbanConfigSchema` (#36411). Proposed shape: `cardFooter: { comments?: boolean, attachments?: boolean }` (an object, so a later time-in-column member is additive). Declarations for the build: `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: added`, with a `Skills-docs:` line owed.

**Overlap with #36520 (branch in development):** no hand-written conflict on the planned item-1 hunks. The generated `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx` and the strictness-ledger counts collide, which regeneration after merge resolves. Planned order: build item 1 from main after #36520 lands.

Size: item 1 M with item 2 deferred. Routing questions (item 2 route, comment-count meaning, acceptance wording) are with the seat.

## Maintainer ruling · item 2 (time in column) · 2026-11-24T04:40Z

Asked on a decision card, with four options: defer it to a separate needs-decision card; a view key naming an author date field; a platform stage-entered timestamp; derive it from sys_activity. The options were reviewed independently first. The maintainer answered, verbatim: 「不需要这个功能」.

**Ruling:** item 2 (time in column) is dropped from this card. No follow-up card is filed for it. This card's acceptance is item 1 alone (the comment and attachment counts in the card footer), with the seat routes from ux-B's readings 7121884710:
- the comment count is the unresolved-thread count, using the same reader as the record-page icon (this is the kanban half of #36062 stage-2 item 11);
- the acceptance reads "one grouped read per counted object over the loaded cards, never one per card";
- the footer key shape (`cardFooter: { comments?, attachments? }`, proposed) is judged by the contract L2.
